#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <set>
#include <map>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

const double eps = 1e-8;

class Point {
public:
    double x, y;

    Point() : x(0), y(0) {}
    Point(double x_, double y_) : x(x_), y(y_) {}

    Point add(const Point& o) const {
        return Point(x + o.x, y + o.y);
    }
    Point sub(const Point& o) const {
        return Point(x - o.x, y - o.y);
    }
    Point rotate(double alpha) const {
        double c = cos(alpha);
        double s = sin(alpha);
        return Point(x * c - y * s, x * s + y * c);
    }
    Point norm() const {
        double len = length();
        if (len < eps) return Point(0, 0);
        return scale(1.0 / len);
    }
    Point scale(double f) const {
        return Point(f * x, f * y);
    }
    double length() const {
        return sqrt(x * x + y * y);
    }
    bool equals(const Point& o) const {
        return fabs(x - o.x) < eps && fabs(y - o.y) < eps;
    }
    int compareTo(const Point& o) const {
        if (fabs(x - o.x) > eps)
            return x < o.x ? -1 : 1;
        if (fabs(y - o.y) > eps)
            return y < o.y ? -1 : 1;
        return 0;
    }
    string toString() const {
        char buf[100];
        snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%.6f %.6f", x, y);
        return string(buf);
    }
};

class Circle {
public:
    Point o;
    double r;

    Circle() : r(0) {}
    Circle(Point o_, double r_) : o(o_), r(r_) {}

    bool contains(const Point& p) const {
        double dist = p.sub(o).length();
        return fabs(dist - r) < eps;
    }
};

vector<Point> intersect(const Circle& c1, const Circle& c2) {
    double dx = c1.o.x - c2.o.x;
    double dy = c1.o.y - c2.o.y;
    double d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    double cosVal = (c1.r * c1.r + d * d - c2.r * c2.r) / (2 * c1.r * d);
    if (cosVal < -1 - eps) {
        return {};
    }
    if (cosVal < -1) {
        cosVal = -1;
    }
    if (cosVal > 1 + eps) {
        return {};
    }
    if (cosVal > 1) {
        cosVal = 1;
    }
    vector<Point> res;
    double alpha = acos(cosVal);
    Point dir = c2.o.sub(c1.o).norm();
    res.push_back(c1.o.add(dir.scale(c1.r).rotate(+alpha)));
    res.push_back(c1.o.add(dir.scale(c1.r).rotate(-alpha)));
    return res;
}

void dfs(int i, vector<bool>& was, vector<vector<int>>& adj) {
    was[i] = true;
    for (int j : adj[i]) {
        if (!was[j]) {
            dfs(j, was, adj);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<Circle> circles(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int x, y, r;
        cin >> x >> y >> r;
        circles[i] = Circle(Point(x, y), r);
    }

    set<Point> all;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
            vector<Point> interPoints = intersect(circles[i], circles[j]);
            if (interPoints.empty()) continue;
            for (auto& p : interPoints) {
                all.insert(p);
            }
        }
    }

    map<Point, int> pointId;
    vector<vector<int>> adj;
    auto getId = [&](const Point& p) {
        auto it = pointId.find(p);
        if (it == pointId.end()) {
            int sz = (int)pointId.size();
            pointId[p] = sz;
            adj.push_back(vector<int>());
            return sz;
        } else {
            return it->second;
        }
    };

    const double PI2 = 2.0 * M_PI;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        vector<double> angles;
        const int K = 3;
        for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
            angles.push_back(PI2 * j / K);
        }
        for (const auto& p : all) {
            if (circles[i].contains(p)) {
                double dx = p.x - circles[i].o.x;
                double dy = p.y - circles[i].o.y;
                double alpha = atan2(dy, dx);
                if (alpha < 0) alpha += PI2;
                angles.push_back(alpha);
            }
        }
        sort(angles.begin(), angles.end());
        Point dir = Point(1, 0).scale(circles[i].r);
        vector<double> uniqueAngles = angles;
        // Remove duplicates within eps
        uniqueAngles.erase(unique(uniqueAngles.begin(), uniqueAngles.end(), [](double a, double b) {
            return fabs(a - b) < eps;
        }), uniqueAngles.end());

        vector<Point> pts;
        for (double a : uniqueAngles) {
            Point p = circles[i].o.add(dir.rotate(a));
            int id = getId(p);
            // Just populate adj list
        }

        int sz = (int)uniqueAngles.size();
        for (int j = 0; j < sz; j++) {
            Point p1 = circles[i].o.add(dir.rotate(uniqueAngles[j]));
            Point p2 = circles[i].o.add(dir.rotate(uniqueAngles[(j + 1) % sz]));
            int u = getId(p1);
            int v = getId(p2);
            if (u != v) {
                adj[u].push_back(v);
                adj[v].push_back(u);
            }
        }
    }

    int v_size = (int)adj.size();
    int e = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < v_size; i++) {
        e += (int)adj[i].size();
    }
    e /= 2;
    int comps = 0;
    vector<bool> was(v_size, false);
    for (int i = 0; i < v_size; i++) {
        if (!was[i]) {
            ++comps;
            dfs(i, was, adj);
        }
    }
    cout << 1 + comps + e - v_size << "\n";

    return 0;
}
